title: Perron-Frobenius For Positive Matrices
body_html:
Perron-Frobenius For Positive Matrices

Let $B$ be a square matrix whose entries are strictly positive. Then $B$ has an eigenvector with strictly positive components associated to a positive eigenvalue.

References

  • [MFoGT, Section 2.8, Exercise 1(2)] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Application of Loomis theorem to positive matrices.
